title: The eight ict_scalp_* legs route to no harness — the same defect E25 just fixed for fvg_range, at eight times the size
note:
OPENED 2026-09-22 off E25's finding (#12714). WORKED 2026-09-22 by this lane on branch e28-ict-scalp-harness-route.

[!] IT IS NOT THE SAME SHAPE AS E25, AND THE DIFFERENCE IS THE WHOLE ROW. E25 added a classifier branch and a lever map to a harness that already took every parameter on the command line. backtest_ict_scalp.py declares NO flag for any of the fourteen keys src/units/strategies/ict_scalp.py::_DEFAULTS consumes, so the '--ignore-yaml and forward every param' half of this row's design call DOES NOT EXIST -- read off the harness's own add_argument list, not its docstring. The YAML read is load-bearing. AND the other half was UNSOUND AS SHIPPED: _load_yaml_params() read the ict_scalp_5m block for every leg (MI-321 measured this on 2026-09-18 and filed it explicitly unfixed, the file being outside that lane's Tier-1 surface; MI-242 has since put scripts/backtest_*.py inside it). Routing eight legs at the old signature would have measured ONE leg's config eight times under eight names and written eight coverage_state=measured records -- strictly worse than the no_harness they replace, because a wrong number reads as evidence and a missing one does not. So the design call resolved to: FIX THE READ FIRST (--strategy-name now selects the block and RAISES on an unknown name), then trust it, and forward only the levers the YAML read cannot reach (the exit levers and the HTF geometry, which are run_backtest KEYWORDS rather than cfg keys, plus --sim-breakeven, which the live monitor genuinely arms from be_offset_bps).

THE EIGHT VERDICTS, against RULE-D1-STAGE0-NET-OF-FULL-COST (registered 2026-09-22T05:34:08Z, BEFORE every run), net of fee 7.5 / slippage 5.0 / funding 1.0 bps roundtrip, over 365d of real bars from data.binance.vision (2025-09-22 -> 2026-09-21). Nothing was tuned, re-split or re-windowed:
  ict_scalp_5m      BTC  5m  FAIL  net_r -16.8140  n=193  folds+ 1/4  faithful
  ict_scalp_sol_5m  SOL  5m  FAIL  net_r -14.7099  n=258  folds+ 1/4  faithful
  ict_scalp_avax_5m AVAX 5m  FAIL  net_r -13.5621  n=261  folds+ 1/4  faithful
  ict_scalp_xrp_5m  XRP  5m  FAIL  net_r  -8.2061  n=245  folds+ 2/4  APPROXIMATE (off_cells + vol_spec)
  ict_scalp_eth_15m ETH 15m  PASS  net_r  +7.9357  n=120  folds+ 2/4  faithful
  ict_scalp_sol_15m SOL 15m  PASS  net_r  +4.0692  n=133  folds+ 2/4  faithful
  ict_scalp_xrp_15m XRP 15m  PASS  net_r  +1.1225  n=130  folds+ 2/4  faithful
  ict_scalp_mgc_15m MGC 15m  harness_failed -- REASON STATED, not dressed up as anything else.

[!] THE RESULT IS A CLEAN TIMEFRAME SPLIT AND THE COST STACK IS WHAT CAUSES IT. All seven measured legs are POSITIVE fee-only (+2.37 to +13.76R); four flip negative once slippage and funding are on. SOL is the controlled comparison -- identical params, identical symbol: 5m is -14.7099 over n=258, 15m is +4.0692 over n=133. XRP the same: -8.2061/n=245 vs +1.1225/n=130. Cost is charged per trade, so the 5m legs pay roughly twice the stack for the same per-trade edge. This is R1's '3 of 11 flipped' class again, at 4 of 7.

[!] A DEMOTION FINDING FOR THE MANAGER, NOT THIS PR'S TO ACT ON. Four legs grade fail and three pass; that is Tier-3 and the diff touches neither config/accounts.yaml nor config/strategies.yaml. URGENCY IS LOW AND THE ROW ALREADY SAID SO -- I re-verified it rather than carrying it: all eight sit on bybit_1 (7) and ib_paper (1), both account_class: paper, and check_roster_promotion_evidence.py --population today lists 8 risk-bearing slots (not the 12 this row was opened with -- R2's four cuts landed in between) and none of the eight is among them. NO REAL MONEY RIDES ON THIS.

[!] ict_scalp_xrp_5m's NUMBER IS THE UNGATED ARM, and that is not fixable from here. MI-321 graded its off_cells not_expressible (the live builder suppresses an entry on it; the key occurs 0 times in the harness and no flag exists) and its vol_spec an asymmetric_gate (--vol-spec-json exists and reaches no skip, so forwarding it would LABEL a run with a spec while it behaves as if unset). The record grades approximate and names both. The live builder's own docstring says the ungated arm fails 2 of 4 folds while the gated arm passes 4/4 -- so this leg's fail is the arm the harness can produce, not a verdict on the leg as it runs.

EN ROUTE, A SECOND DEFECT ONLY THIS CHANGE MADE REACHABLE (E25's own pattern). mgc is the one non-USDT leg, so this is the first time anything asked Yahoo for 15m over 365d. It returned empty and _yahoo_empty_reason blamed the TICKER -- 'delisting, a short listing history, or a wrong symbol map' -- because its SPY control probes period=5d/interval=1d and so varies along NEITHER axis under test. MEASURED: GC=F at 15m returns 4,338 rows over 5d and 0 over 365d, with Yahoo's own error naming the 60-day limit. The symbol map is CORRECT. A fourth state (window_exceeds_intraday_limit) and a same-interval self-probe now separate them. A wrong named cause is worse than an unexplained failure: it closes off the investigation.

POPULATION, re-measured rather than asserted: over the 52 enabled legs, routed 43 -> 51, unrouted 9 -> 1 (turtle_soup alone), faithful 30 -> 37 (71.2%). E25's negative control in test_regime_debt_matrix_fvg_range.py named ict_scalp_5m as its example of an unroutable leg and is re-anchored here -- a control tied to one leg stops being a control the moment that leg is fixed.
